stock.description: Changhong Jiahua Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the distribution of a wide array of information and communication technology (ICT) products for both consumer and corporate clients, in addition to other services throughout the People's Republic of China. Its consumer-focused ICT division supplies personal computers, various digital devices, and IT accessories. The corporate ICT segment offers solutions such as data storage systems, minicomputers, networking equipment, PC servers, intelligent building management technologies, and unified communication and contact center platforms. Beyond these, its 'Other Products' category includes the distribution of smartphones, the development of proprietary intelligent terminal devices, the sale of extended warranty packages, and the provision of comprehensive integrated ICT solutions and professional services. The company, which was formerly known as China Data Broadcasting Holdings Limited, formally adopted its current name, Changhong Jiahua Holdings Limited, in January 2013. Headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, it operates as a subsidiary of Sichuan Changhong Electronic Co., Limited.
